description: Java class for deserializing and validating JSON input for Teller API commands in the Fineract project.

classes.name: TellerCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A final class annotated as a Spring component, responsible for deserializing and validating JSON input for Teller API commands.

methods.name: validateForCreateAndUpdateTeller
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating or updating a Teller, checking required fields and date logic.

methods.name: validateForAllocateCashier
methods.description: Validates JSON input for allocating a cashier to a Teller, including staff ID and time parameters.

methods.name: validateForCashTxnForCashier
methods.description: Validates JSON input for cash transactions related to a cashier, including amount, date, note, and currency.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws validation exception if any validation errors are present.
